tickets.description: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Design the real-time update pipeline for retro board, including:"}]},{"type":"bulletList","content":[{"type":"listItem","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"necessary events for the update pipeline"},{"type":"hardBreak"}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"User Story"}]},{"type":"paragraph"},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"As a project team member working in the Retro section,"}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I want to see ticket changes (add, delete, move) made by other collaborators in real-time without refreshing,"}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"so that we can collaborate more effectively during retrospectives and avoid miscommunication or outdated views."}]},{"type":"paragraph"},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"Narrative"}]},{"type":"paragraph"},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Retro section is a key space for teams to reflect and identify actions for improvement. This disrupts collaboration and reduces the effectiveness of live retrospectives."}]},{"type":"paragraph"},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"To support real-time collaboration, TechScrum should allow all changes within the Retro tab to automatically appear for all participants without needing to refresh. This applies only to the Retro section and does not include Board or Backlog tabs.
